182:t_10:6.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「I-I'm sorry... I just get frightened when you're near me, $$ＡＧ$$...」

182:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But your knight, $$ジン$$, isn't here now.」

182:t_10:8.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「...I don't intend to rely on $$ジン$$ forever. If $$ミカゲ$$ goes after him again, I'll protect $$ジン$$ myself!」

182:t_10:9.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「I'll get stronger for that...! I won't lose to you either, $$ＡＧ$$!」

182:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That's right, $$ユノハ$$. Don't forget the determination you had when you unleashed that finishing move.)

182:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Your strong feelings then produced 50 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add them to the team's stock.)

182:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... It feels so wonderful to have the tables turned on me...」

182:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please don't be so wary. I intend to share a secret method for preventing nightmares with you.」

182:t_10:24.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're just going to sell me some shady product at $$Ｄトレーダー$$...!」

182:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How rude! This method is 100% natural, has no side effects, and costs nothing!」

182:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Wear out your mind and body by shouting, and you'll sleep like a log!」

182:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Here we go! Let's give it our all today...!」

182:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Come now! One more time! Let's give it our all today...!」

182:t_10:31.en:
$$アルト$$
「I told you I'm not doing it!」

182:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We're not done yet! Let's give it our all today...!」

182:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That goes for both of us! Now, let's give it our all today...!」

182:t_10:35.en:
$$アルト$$
「There's no way I'm doing it!」

182:t_10:40.en:
$$アルト$$
「You... You were trying to make me shout...」

182:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't worry. As I said before, this service is on the house.」

182:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then please show that gratitude in action! Let's give it our all today...!」

182:t_10:44.en:
$$アルト$$
「I told you, I'm not doing it!」

182:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Come now! Please reconsider! Let's give it our all today...!」

182:t_10:46.en:
$$アルト$$
「You really don't know when to quit!」

183:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Come back, Ensign $$アルト$$! You haven't been ordered to launch!」

183:t_001:0.en:
$$ボビー$$
「What's gotten into you, $$アルト$$!?」

183:t_001:1.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「Is he stressed because we don't know where $$ランカ$$ is?」

183:t_001:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「First, we stop him. Have Major $$オズマ$$ take command.」

183:t_001:4.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Wait, Captain! There's a contact on radar!」

183:t_002:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Scramble! Get them out there now!」

183:t_003:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Get back! $$インベーダー#robot$$s are coming!」

183:t_004:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「If you're awake, get yourself together, now! Or do you want to die!?」

183:t_004:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「B-Big Sis! They're starfish! They're gross! They're $$コスモ星丸$$!」

183:t_004:7.en:
$$チコ$$
「Are those the parallel world's $$宇宙怪獣$$ we've heard about?」

183:t_004:8.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「No... They're creatures called $$インベーダー#robot$$s. Well... They're not much different from $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

183:t_004:9.en:
$$レド$$
「I never imagined they'd be out here on the frontier too.」

183:t_004:10.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. The $$人類銀河同盟$$ classifies these entities as Special Class One dangerous organisms.」

183:t_004:11.en:
$$ガロード$$
「So they're about as dangerous as the 《$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$》 $$レド$$ and his people fought?」

183:t_004:12.en:
$$ロラン$$
「All of you $$トップレス$$, be careful too. Like $$宇宙怪獣$$, they're beings called $$バアル$$.」

183:t_004:13.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「There's no way we can reach an understanding with monsters like those.」

183:t_004:14.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That's how it is, $$刹那$$.」

183:t_004:15.en:
$$刹那$$
「I know. If they intend to annihilate humanity, we'll fight them.」

183:t_004:16.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh... You're fired up too, Big Bro $$刹那$$!」

183:t_004:17.en:
$$スザク$$
「Don't let your guard down, $$勝平$$. The $$インベーダー#robot$$s have become even stronger since the $$再世戦争$$.」

183:t_004:18.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They're ravenous destroyers... They evolve, seeking more power to satisfy their own desires.」

183:t_004:19.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Now that the $$時の牢獄$$ is gone, they're coming from outer space...」

183:t_004:20.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I won't let them wipe us out without a fight.」

183:t_004:21.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Since we rejected $$エタニティ・フラット$$, we knew we'd have to fight $$バアル$$.」

183:t_004:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go! We'll make them regret crawling all the way to Earth!」

183:t_004:24.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$n, don't forget the tips I taught you for controlling your machine.」

183:t_004:25.en:
$$ランド$$
「Or the smile I taught you!」

183:t_004:27.en:
$$甲児$$
「So $n... got coaching from $$ランド$$ and $$セツコ$$.」

183:t_004:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「Seeing how reckless he is makes you want to look after him.」
